title: Grateful Dead Live at Straight Theater, Haight Street on 1967-07-23
lineage: recording released as a flexi-disc in the 1st printing of The Dead Book

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a rare Neal Cassady rap and the earliest Lovelight fragment, but the recording is incomplete.
ai_review.review: The file contains a fascinating spoken‑word segment by Neal Cassady (often cited as the “Straight Theater rap”) plus a brief excerpt of the very first known performance of "Lovelight." The source appears to be a soundboard flex‑record, offering decent clarity for what it is, yet the track is only eight minutes long and missing much of the original material. Listeners appreciate the historical value but note that the recording is far from a complete concert experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed 4‑star reviews highlight unique content and reasonable sound quality, while also noting the incompleteness of the recording; overall rating reflects strong historical interest but limited musical substance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Soundboard source gives decent clarity, but the track is truncated (only ~8 min) and missing large portions of the original performance; no major distortion reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Not applicable – the file is a spoken‑word rap with a brief music excerpt rather than a full concert set.
